decision: Pause M4 until the receiver delivery channel is qualified at the exact failed injection depth and the receiver-scale oracle reports.

profiles.purpose: Qualify the exact receiver block used by the failed L18 to L14 cross-model path.
Measure self-pair channel capacity at the matched half-depth above the registered receiver-scale threshold.

protocol.pool_operation: arithmetic mean over captured generated-token residual rows
protocol.base_normalization: rescale identity vector to the receiver natural median per-position L2 norm at the registered injection block

conditions.baseline_uninjected: No residual edit, same slotted prompt.
conditions.zero_vector: True zero vector through all eight real overwrite positions.
conditions.identity: The model's own mean-pooled residual captured at the profile capture block and injected at the same profile block.
conditions.matched_random: Per-item seeded Gaussian direction with the exact effective L2 norm of the corresponding identity condition.

protocol.secondary_diagnostic: Paired teacher-forced mean NLL of the gold numeric answer under every condition.
forbidden: Changing the item set, seed, gain list, execution order, profile depth, slot count, normalization, threshold, or control after any profile starts.
Probing the ADR-024 anchor cell as an unregistered extra draw.
Selecting the best gain post hoc as the primary result.
Proceeding when registration, source receipt, dataset, model identity, layer count, hidden size, or item-set validation fails.

statistics.primary_test: one-sided exact paired sign test on discordant accuracy outcomes, identity greater than matched random
statistics.stability_test: one-sided exact paired sign test on each adjacent gain, Holm corrected as a two-hypothesis family
statistics.zero_vector_gate: zero-vector correct count must be at least half the baseline-uninjected correct count
statistics.nll_role: diagnostic only, never substitutes for the accuracy gate
statistics.effect_reporting: Report raw correct counts, paired wins and losses, exact p values, Holm adjusted p values, and accuracy deltas for every gain and both profiles.

profile_pass: The primary gain meets both primary_alpha and primary_min_accuracy_delta.
At least one registered adjacent gain meets both the Holm-corrected stability threshold and stability_min_accuracy_delta.

ladder_decision.both_profiles_fail: Stop the mid-layer adapter ladder and move to the separately registered latent-prefix delivery contingency.
ladder_decision.one_point_five_fails_three_passes: Keep M4 blocked on the 1.5B receiver and preregister a genuinely cross-model receiver-scale arm before training another adapter.
ladder_decision.one_point_five_passes: The exact 1.5B delivery path is qualified; M4 may resume under ADR-024, with the 3B result retained as a scale diagnostic.
ladder_decision.one_point_five_passes_three_fails: Do not generalize across scale; investigate model or layer-specific channel instability before claiming a receiver-scale law.

scope_limits: The 3B self-pair profile is an oracle capacity diagnostic, not the mandatory cross-model scale-control arm already registered by ADR-024.
A 3B oracle pass authorizes design of a fresh cross-model scale arm; it does not make the existing 3B to 1.5B MLP result positive.
This protocol tests channel capacity and gain sensitivity, not semantic universality or production safety.
